overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies black salt powder for wholesale, private label, and export needs. The product is processed from selected black salt material, then cleaned, ground, and sieved under controlled conditions to achieve a fine, free-flowing powder. Buyers can request standard grades or customer-specific mesh, packing, and labeling support.

This black salt powder is a practical ingredient for food manufacturers, brands, distributors, and foodservice buyers. It blends well in dry and wet applications, including seasoning systems and recipe development. We offer bulk supply, samples on request, export documentation support, and flexible packaging options to suit commercial requirements.
industries: Spice packers and private label buyers

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: The MOQ is 5 Kg for black salt powder.

faqs.q: Can you support private label and OEM orders?
faqs.a: Yes. We support OEM and private label packing for commercial buyers.

faqs.q: Can I request a different mesh size or packaging format?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom mesh and packaging can be arranged on request.
We offer 25 kg bags, 25 kg HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you provide samples before bulk order confirmation?
faqs.a: Yes. Samples are available on request for evaluation.

faqs.q: Do you provide export support documents?
faqs.a: Yes. We support export documentation for commercial shipments.
